reviews.text:
Could not be any happier with the service from these wonderful ladies. They care about our dogs, treat them very well.
Good groomers are hard to find but clipperz are one of the best. Highly recommend them. Ruth the owner is amazing with her knowledge, skills and she is extremely friendly. Ruth also runs a training programme for new students to obtain the best skill required, obtain a qualification to look after our wonderful pets.
The two ladies were so gentle and friendly to us and our dog I highly recommend this groomers to anyone suffering with there dog with long nails thank you so much ladies you made my absolute day xxxx
Absolutely brilliant place walked in no booking got my dogs nails clipped so quick and stress free lovely staff and very cheap I would highly recommend to everyone
My dog loves going here. He's always a good boy :)
Murphy had a lovely first experience
